dict.string: LightStar uses Bluetooth to discover and control your BLE LED light bar. Without this permission the app cannot connect to any device.
LightStar uses Bluetooth to discover and control your BLE LED light bar. Without this permission the app cannot connect to any device.
LightStar listens to microphone input to sync the light to music beats when the Microphone source is selected in Audio Sync.
LightStar captures the screen to sync your LED bar colors to what's on display (Ambilight-style).
LightStar advertises itself on the local network so the iPhone remote can reach this Mac.
LightStar quits Chrome, Edge, or Brave to toggle hardware acceleration for Screen sync, and sends play, next, and previous to Music or Spotify from the iPhone remote.
